content.text: {"explanations":[{"signal_id":"b752752d-92cd-42ce-9a29-cf8ad414c4e7","explanation":"Total leverage of {{fact:cf09aa30-14d6-4214-b8dc-b7369f0a5824}} is above the {{fact:cf5ce94d-59c2-485d-ac3c-f864cf033957}} maximum, so headroom is negative at {{fact:b1a2482c-4174-437b-956c-da582a08fa26}}. On these figures the covenant appears already breached, not merely tight. Debt is high relative to earnings while the liquidity cushion is also shrinking."},{"signal_id":"02c93a41-8953-4c48-a708-caec5e2d8777","explanation":"The current ratio of {{fact:0f340d0e-1385-41ee-a0dd-bda8b6003f21}} sits just above its {{fact:13194732-46fe-4a3a-afd0-41790b749b4f}} floor, leaving headroom of only {{fact:9e590747-9307-45f2-be07-cc4a806e601c}}. That is a thin short-term liquidity cushion. Alongside the leverage overshoot, it points to pressure on both debt capacity and near-term cash."},{"signal_id":"afab9352-9ae8-4d64-9cd7-ed30bab16d21","explanation":"Current ratio headroom slipped from {{fact:c016ad45-01b1-4a84-9ef1-bd2b68269efc}} in March to {{fact:f33cbd85-a873-4f98-99bf-bd4fb0d746df}} in June. It then fell sharply to {{fact:9e590747-9307-45f2-be07-cc4a806e601c}} by September.
